name: Gambonanza
detailed_description:
Experience a Chess Revolution

Step into the wild world of Gambonanza, where traditional chess is reimagined into a fast-paced, strategy-packed roguelike adventure. In this game, victory isn’t about capturing just the king—it’s about capturing every single piece on the board through masterful synergies!

About Gambonanza

Inspired by classic chess yet bursting with innovative twists, Gambonanza challenges you to think creatively and strategically. Every run is a fresh puzzle, where your decisions, tactics, and the perfect synergy between your chess pieces and Gambits determine your success. Assemble your ultimate strategy by:

  • Unlocking Gambits: Discover over 100+ powerful Gambits that, when combined with your chess pieces, create explosive combos capable of outsmarting even the toughest opponents.

  • Mastering Chess Mechanics: Learn to utilize a dynamic reserve system that lets you store extra chess pieces off-board and deploy them at the perfect moment to catch your adversary off guard.

  • Upgrading Your Board: Customize your chessboard with unique tiles—turn pieces into gold with shimmering golden squares to boost your income, recover captured pieces with blessing tiles, or safeguard your moves with protective tiles for daring, decisive maneuvers.

Every element of Gambonanza works in harmony to help you build the ultimate strategy to overcome five formidable though bosses!

Key Features

  • Synergistic Gambits & Pieces: Combine your chess pieces with over 100+ Gambits to unlock devastating combos and strategic surprises.

  • Dynamic Reserve System: Keep a stock of extra pieces off-board and deploy them at crucial moments to shift the balance of power.

  • Strategic Board Upgrades: Enhance your chessboard with golden squares, blessing tiles, protective surfaces, and more—each adding a unique tactical edge.

  • Retro Aesthetic & Quirky Ambiance: Immerse yourself in vibrant pixel art with a nostalgic CRT filter, evoking the playful excitement of a fairground.

  • Engaging Mini-Games: Test your luck and skill in challenges inspired by pachinko, slot machines, and Gachapon—each offering game-changing upgrades.

Unleash the full potential of your chess pieces and Gambits, build unstoppable synergies, and conquer the ultimate challenge: defeating the five chess bosses!
Are you ready to redefine chess?

Discover Gambonanza on Steam and embark on a strategic adventure like no other!

short_description: Gambonanza is a mind-bending roguelike where every move counts. Unlock over 100 innovative Gambits and harness powerful synergy with your chess pieces to transform your board into a festival of explosive combos and tactical twists!
supported_languages:
English*, French*, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Microsoft® Windows® 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 450 MB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.11 (El Capitan)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 2.6 GHz 64 bits Processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL compatible graphics card with at least 512MB of video memory
  • Storage: 450 MB available space
  • Additional Notes: Run on both Apple M1 and Intel Core M

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: x64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support.
  • Memory: 2 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated graphics should be enough
  • Storage: 450 MB available space
